info.title: Skyewallet Business API
info.description:
Payment infrastructure for African businesses — accept, send, and settle crypto and fiat payments via a single REST API.

All endpoints are under `/v1/`. Authenticate with your secret API key in the `Authorization` header.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Your secret API key (`sk_live_...` or `sk_test_...`). Never expose this client-side.

message.example: Your USDT wallet does not have enough balance.

type.description: `dynamic` for one-time payment with expiry; `static` for permanent reusable address

amount.description: Required for dynamic accounts. Expected payment total.

post.description: Get a locked exchange rate. Valid for 30 seconds.
Execute a previously obtained quote. Quote must not have expired.

Returns all active allowlisted currencies. Crypto entries include supported networks.

List all enabled crypto currencies with supported networks.

post.summary: Validate a customer (BVN or bank account)
post.description: Validates a customer using either BVN resolution (sync via Bani) or bank account validation (async via Paystack). For BVN type, the customer is auto-validated if the name matches. For bank_account type, the result is delivered via webhook (`customeridentification.success` / `customeridentification.failed`).

202.description: Bank account validation submitted for processing
